narrative.overview: A low-lit fireside that suits any hour of the day. Surfaces are dark and faintly green, and the only light comes from the stories themselves: covers glow in their series colour, and one soft lime accent marks what to press.
keyCharacteristics: Dark, green-tinted tonal layers instead of shadows.
One lime accent per screen, used as a fill with dark ink; pastel world and series colours appear as glows and tints.
Pills and soft 16-26px corners everywhere; nothing sharp.
Line-icon covers on a tinted gradient tile; the icon is the art.
System fonts and Georgia only; no network requests.

rules.name: The One Lime Rule
rules.body: The accent marks what to press or what is playing. It is never decoration, and a screen has one primary accent fill.

rules.name: The Vetted Colour Rule
rules.body: Colours come from the fixed palette or the tokens file, never generated. A new pair must pass `scripts/check-token-contrast.mjs` before it is added.

rules.name: The Hairline Honesty Rule
rules.body: Anything a person must find to use goes in Control Line. Hairline is only for edges that could vanish without harm.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Serif is for stories (titles, text); sans is for operating the app. Do not use serif for buttons or sans for story text.

rules.name: The Floor Rule
rules.body: Body is at least 16px, labels at least 12px, with no exceptions for density.

rules.name: The Never-Cover Rule
rules.body: Fixed chrome must yield to content in short viewports and zoom.

rules.name: The Glow Is The Story Rule
rules.body: Glow belongs to covers and the play button. Cards and chrome do not glow.

dos: **Do** use 56px for primary controls (play, seek, Continue) and at least 44px for everything else.
**Do** keep one lime fill per screen and let pastel series colours appear as glows and tints.
**Do** build depth from the tonal stack (Night, Surface, Raised) and soft radial glows.
**Do** honour `prefers-reduced-motion`; motion is a 0.2s sheet slide and 0.15s chevrons only.
**Do** read every colour from `tokens.css`; new pairs must pass `scripts/check-token-contrast.mjs`.
donts: **Don't** use bright primary colours, cartoon styling, confetti or mascots.
**Don't** add a light theme, or bouncing, flashing or looping motion.
**Don't** use Hairline for anything a person needs to find; use Control Line.
**Don't** put text below 12px or body below 16px, or use external fonts or other network requests.
**Don't** put pastel world colours behind light text; they carry dark Series Ink.
**Don't** nest accent fills or add glows to cards and chrome.
